source_refs.note: 'Using Excel for Data Analysis' under topic 6.10, as printed (PDF 88, printed 84).

blocks.text: Excel is widely used for basic data analysis by organizing the data in rows and columns. Excel supports sorting, filtering, and data visualization using charts. Charts help visualize data. Simple formulas perform calculations. Excel is easy to learn and is useful for small datasets. Beginners often start with Excel, and it supports early data understanding.
